text: Apple and Nvidia alternated as the largest publicly traded company by market capitalization during the trading session. Market value remained concentrated in the two firms while their year-to-date equity performance differed. Leadership by market capitalization remained unresolved at the session's conclusion.

meta.note: The entry captures the observed leadership contest without incorporating analyst rationale or sector interpretation.

text: SpaceX shares declined nearly 23% from their level at Nasdaq-100 inclusion as an aborted Starship test flight delayed another launch attempt. Rocket testing continued under FAA oversight while public equity markets repriced the company following its recent IPO.

meta.note: Operational testing continued despite the launch abort; no permanent program interruption was reported.

text: Taco Bell voluntarily removed shredded iceberg lettuce from its U.S. supply chain after public health officials linked it to a multistate cyclosporiasis outbreak. Regulatory traceback and supplier investigations continued while restaurant operations remained active using revised ingredients.

meta.note: The entry captures the operational response; the outbreak investigation and supplier traceback remained ongoing.
